literal_meaning: পেটের ব্যবসা বা কাজ (stomach's business or affair)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পেটের ধান্ধায় সে সারাদিন পরিশ্রম করে।
example_sentences_in_english: My line of work is farming.
He toils all day for his daily bread.
note: Refers to basic means of earning to sustain oneself, common in agrarian Bengali society.
